status: Frozen before candidate execution; not a production rule
purpose: Recover a detached printed hairpin below the last physical staff without changing ordinary component ownership or general crop padding
scope: Only ordinary unowned components wholly below the last physical staff; top within six staff spaces of its lowest line; above/between-staff cases untouched

sourceGeometry.sourceRuns: Original threshold pixels within the component bbox, every interior x column; zero or more than two runs rejects except at most ten percent missing columns
sourceGeometry.singleRunLocation: Only the closing end's final twenty percent of component width
sourceGeometry.lineFits: Least-squares fit to each of two run centers; maximum residual max(1 pixel, 0.12 staff spaces)

preservation: Keep every original component; append a typed outward-only component with exactly the detected bbox and the final staff ID. Existing planner clearance applies; no recursive chaining or general padding change.
acceptance: Original p4 frozen target retained; no ordinary component or existing crop shrinks; no new staff cores imported; existing controls unchanged; inspect every source-real expansion. Reject any discovered ownership regression.
